subject: Private deployment: schedule VPC architecture review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Bob Johnson <bob.johnson@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-10T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Private deployment: schedule VPC architecture review

Hi Bob —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call:

- Goal: Evaluate Private deployment (VPC + on-prem option) for Acme Retail to host inference for customer-facing recommendation models.
- Key constraints you mentioned: strict network ingress controls, no public egress from the model subnet, and corporate KMS for key management.
- Success criteria for the tech review: confirm network design, requirements for bastion/VPN, storage and logging access patterns, and any regulatory controls that affect deployment.

Next step: schedule a 60-minute architecture review / technical deep dive with your infra and security leads + our infra and security engineers. Availability from our side (PT):
- Wed Feb 16, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Feb 17, 14:00–15:00 PT

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your team will join (network, security, infra)? If you have a current network diagram or any firewall egress rules, please attach or drop a link — that will help us keep the meeting focused.

I've attached a brief checklist that we use to prep for Private deployments (redwood_private_vpc_checklist.xlsx).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_private_vpc_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Bob Johnson <bob.johnson@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T20:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: schedule VPC architecture review

Marissa —

Great summary, thanks. Thu Feb 17, 14:00–15:00 PT works for us. I'll have our infra lead (Alice Park) and one of our security engineers join. They may also want to see your SOC2 and KMS integration docs ahead of time — do you have a link you can share?

For prep, I'll upload our current network diagram and firewall rules to the HubSpot ticket, but please let us know if you need anything more specific. Looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Bob Johnson
Director of Infrastructure | Acme Retail
bob.johnson@acmeretail.com
(312) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Bob Johnson <bob.johnson@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-11T09:16:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: schedule VPC architecture review

Thanks, Bob — Thu Feb 17, 14:00–15:00 PT is confirmed. I'll send a calendar invite shortly (invite.ics).

Pre-reads and links:
- SOC 2 summary: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-private-vpc (shared)
- Private deployment design template: attached (redwood_private_vpc_template.pdf)
- HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/companies/ACME

Can you please confirm the internal attendees' emails and whether there are any corporate VPN or proxy requirements (e.g., must originate from corporate IP ranges, required client certs)? That will determine whether we present a NAT/bastion pattern or an entirely private egress model.

Action items for the meeting:
- Our side: network diagram for typical Private deployment, KMS integration pattern, logging/audit architecture.
- Your side: current network diagram, firewall rules, list of systems that need egress.

Attachment: redwood_private_vpc_template.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

P.S. I'll add the DocuSign link for the standard MSA to the HubSpot record after the call if you want us to start paperwork early: https://docusign.com/EnvelopeID/ABCDEF123456

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-11T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: schedule VPC architecture review

Looping internally — we'll join the Thu 2–3 PT slot. Mike and I will prepare the network runbook and a short slide deck showing both NAT/bastion and fully private egress options. Priyom will bring the KMS/integration notes.

I'll draft a short agenda:
1) 10 min: introductions + goals
2) 30 min: network/VPC design walkthrough
3) 15 min: KMS + key rotation / logging / audit patterns
4) 5 min: next steps + timeline / action owners

We should ask Bob/Alice for their network diagram in advance so we can tailor the walkthrough.

- Dev
Engineering | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai
